raten-gerisee-albis-afterwork-special.title: Raten · Ägerisee · Albis Afterwork Special
raten-gerisee-albis-afterwork-special.slogan: A 71 km loop out of Albis ridge warm-up
raten-gerisee-albis-afterwork-special.story: Small roads, water light and a proper evening reset. A 71 km loop that starts and ends near Langnau am Albis, about 1 h 21 of riding. The stops in between: Ägerisee water stop and Zug  window. Ratenpass is the high point. It tops out at 1,077 m. It is a high-mountain day.

scenicChapters.title: Zug food window → back to Albis ridge warm-up
scenicChapters.narrative: 19 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

places-cuhixu-uheni-tuy-mayau-2.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-cuhixu-uheni-tuy-mayau-2.story: From Villa de Ramos it runs 172 km to Villa de Ramos; allow about 2 h 58 of riding. On the way it passes Tatei Matiniere, Natsitacua, Tuy Mayau and back through Natsitacua. The highest point is about 2,200 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
